r: I am not a body. I am free. For I am still as God created me.
idea: I trust my brothers, who are one with me.
t: This thought I do not want. I choose instead ______
ev: Besides the time you give morning and evening, which should not be less than fifteen minutes, and the hourly remembrances you make throughout the day, use the idea as often as you can between them.
The day begins and ends with this. And we repeat it every time the hour strikes
